schemes.name: oval_dome_hall_with_a_court
schemes.secondary_language: an oval hall under a dome with a court carved through its centre, so the dome becomes a ring over a lit void
schemes.formal_principle: The jury called the drum inert: a court carved through the centre turns the solid into a ring, and the dome then spans a lit void instead of a filled one - the section gains the interior the drawing lacked.
schemes.dominant_gesture: a domed ring around a carved court
schemes.reference_basis: development of oval_dome_hall_sunk: the oval, the dome and the sunk floor are kept; the jury's inert drum, missing void, unused ground and absent front are answered

design_argument_ko.title: 타원 홀 가운데를 파내 링으로 만들고 돔이 빈 공간을 덮는다.
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: The jury called the drum inert: a court carved through the centre turns the solid into a ring, and the dome then spans a lit void instead of a filled one - the section gains the interior the drawing lacked.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: 파낸 마당의 채광과 배수, 링 폭의 실내 깊이를 검토해야 한다.

ops.why: The hall's own top still rises to its centre - the dome is the parent's idea and every child keeps it.
A court carved at 40% of the body turns the drum into a ring and gives the section a void the jury asked for.
The floor stays a quarter below grade so the figure reads low from the street, as the parent does.

schemes.name: oval_dome_hall_on_a_wide_plinth
schemes.secondary_language: an oval hall under a dome standing on a plinth widened toward the open side to take the ground the parent left
schemes.formal_principle: The jury noted 27% coverage: widening the ground toward the open side takes the allowance the parent left unused and gives the drum a terrace to stand on rather than a residue.
schemes.dominant_gesture: a domed hall on a widened plinth
schemes.reference_basis: development of oval_dome_hall_sunk: the oval, the dome and the sunk floor are kept; the jury's inert drum, missing void, unused ground and absent front are answered

design_argument_ko.title: 열린 변으로 기단을 넓혀 남던 지면을 쓴다.
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: The jury noted 27% coverage: widening the ground toward the open side takes the allowance the parent left unused and gives the drum a terrace to stand on rather than a residue.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: 넓힌 기단의 옥외 이용과 상부 드럼의 하중 전달을 검토해야 한다.

ops.why: The hall's own top still rises to its centre - the dome is the parent's idea and every child keeps it.
The body grows toward the open side so the unused ground becomes plinth and terrace.
The floor stays a quarter below grade so the figure reads low from the street, as the parent does.

schemes.name: oval_dome_hall_broadened_across
schemes.secondary_language: an oval hall under a dome broadened across its short axis so the drum becomes a room-deep hall
schemes.formal_principle: The jury called the drum inert and the ground underused: broadening the oval across its short axis turns a deep drum into a hall with two long faces, so daylight reaches the middle and the plan takes ground the parent left.
schemes.reference_basis: development of oval_dome_hall_sunk: the oval, the dome and the sunk floor are kept; the jury's inert drum, unused ground and absent front are answered

design_argument_ko.title: 짧은 축으로 넓혀 깊은 드럼을 홀로 바꾼다.
design_argument_ko.spatial_strategy: The jury called the drum inert and the ground underused: broadening the oval across its short axis turns a deep drum into a hall with two long faces, so daylight reaches the middle and the plan takes ground the parent left.
design_argument_ko.tradeoff: 넓힌 평면의 중앙 채광과 돔 스팬의 구조를 검토해야 한다.

ops.why: The hall's own top still rises to its centre - the dome is the parent's idea and every child keeps it.
Widening across the short axis makes the plan a hall rather than a drum, and takes ground the parent left unused.
The floor stays a quarter below grade so the figure reads low from the street, as the parent does.

schemes.name: oval_dome_hall_offset_to_the_street
schemes.secondary_language: an oval hall under a dome pushed toward the open side so the street meets the building and the yard falls behind
schemes.formal_principle: The jury found no frontage: offsetting the whole figure toward the open side puts the hall on the street and gathers the leftover ground into one yard behind it, instead of a residue on every side.
schemes.dominant_gesture: a domed oval set to the street
schemes.reference_basis: development of oval_dome_hall_sunk: the oval, the dome and the sunk floor are kept; the jury's inert drum, unused ground and absent front are answered
